name: 台北榮民總醫院
note: 周邊神經科自 1989 年起提供 SCA 突變基因檢測與分子生物診斷，另設基因諮詢門診；為台灣 SCA 基因診斷歷史最久的據點，亦是 Stemchymal 台灣二期的唯一執行中心。

en.name: Taipei Veterans General Hospital
en.note: The Division of Peripheral Nerve Disorders has offered SCA mutation testing and molecular diagnosis since 1989 and runs a genetic counselling clinic; the longest-established SCA genetic diagnosis centre in Taiwan and the sole site of the Taiwan Phase 2 of Stemchymal.

name: 台大醫院
note: 神經部設「肌肉疾病遺傳性疾病（罕見疾病）」門診與動作障礙門診；基因醫學部為國健署認證的 SCA 基因檢驗單位之一。台大雲林分院另設小腦研究中心。

en.name: National Taiwan University Hospital
en.note: Neurology runs both a hereditary/rare neuromuscular disease clinic and a movement disorders clinic; Medical Genetics is among the accredited SCA testing units. The Yunlin branch hosts a dedicated Cerebellar Research Center.

name: 國立陽明交通大學
note: 與台北榮總高度重疊的學術端；另有 SCA19/22 離子通道與 polyQ 藥物開發兩條獨立基礎研究線。

en.name: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University
en.note: The academic counterpart to TVGH with substantial overlap in personnel, plus two independent basic-science lines in SCA19/22 channelopathy and polyQ drug development.

name: 彰化基督教醫院
note: 以 SCA3 治療與生物標記為主軸，院內另有中醫與復健（rTMS）兩項登錄試驗；為中部 SCA 臨床研究的樞紐。

en.name: Changhua Christian Hospital
en.note: Centred on SCA3 therapeutics and biomarkers, with two further registered trials in-house (Chinese medicine and rTMS rehabilitation); the hub of clinical SCA research in central Taiwan.

name: 中國醫藥大學附設醫院
note: 神經免疫暨基因疾病科承接小腦萎縮的基因診斷；另有多位動作障礙學會理監事。

en.name: China Medical University Hospital
en.note: The Division of Neuroimmunology and Genetic Disorders handles genetic diagnosis for cerebellar atrophy; several movement-disorder society officers are based here.

name: 花蓮慈濟醫院
note: 細胞治療與再生醫學的臨床轉譯基地；SCA3 天然物與遞送平台研究（與東華大學合作）。

en.name: Hualien Tzu Chi Hospital
en.note: A translational base for cell therapy and regenerative medicine; runs SCA3 natural-product and delivery-platform research with National Dong Hwa University.

name: 林口長庚醫院
note: 神經肌肉疾病科診療範圍明列脊髓小腦萎縮症，並有動作障礙科與 polyQ 藥物開發線；與台師大長期合作藥物篩選。

en.name: Chang Gung Memorial Hospital, Linkou
en.note: The neuromuscular division's listed scope explicitly includes spinocerebellar ataxia; also hosts a movement disorders division and a polyQ drug-development line with long-running NTNU collaboration.

name: 高雄長庚醫院
note: 南台灣遺傳性共濟失調的世代收案與罕見亞型定性；另有動作障礙醫師群。

en.name: Kaohsiung Chang Gung Memorial Hospital
en.note: Cohort recruitment and rare-subtype characterisation for hereditary ataxia in southern Taiwan, alongside a group of movement-disorder clinicians.

name: 台中榮總
note: 一般神經科提供小腦脊髓萎縮退化症的諮詢、基因送檢與藥物治療。

en.name: Taichung Veterans General Hospital
en.note: General neurology offers consultation, genetic testing referral and pharmacological management for spinocerebellar degeneration.

name: 成功大學／成大醫院
note: 基因性神經疾病門診；基礎端有 SCA3 動物模型研究。病友協會 2024 年紀錄載與成大合作 SCA3 基因轉殖鼠基因治療。

en.name: National Cheng Kung University / NCKUH
en.note: A genetic neurological disease clinic plus basic-science work on SCA3 animal models. The patient association's 2024 record notes a collaboration with NCKU on gene therapy in SCA3 transgenic mice.

name: 中央研究院生物醫學科學研究所
note: 神經退化基礎研究的制度性節點；台大潘明楷於此合聘。

en.name: Institute of Biomedical Sciences, Academia Sinica
en.note: The institutional node for basic neurodegeneration research; NTU's Ming-Kai Pan holds a joint appointment here.

name: 台北醫學大學體系
note: 宋秉文教授晚年任職於此體系（雙和醫院、台北神經醫學中心）；現有動作障礙學會理事長。

en.name: Taipei Medical University system
en.note: Where Professor Bing-Wen Soong worked in his final years (Shuang Ho Hospital and Taipei Neuroscience Institute); currently home to the movement-disorder society's president.

name: 長庚大學物理治療學系
note: 台灣 SCA 復健介入登錄試驗最多的團隊（4 件）。

en.name: Department of Physical Therapy, Chang Gung University
en.note: The most prolific registered-trial group for SCA rehabilitation interventions in Taiwan (four trials).

name: 國立台灣師範大學
note: polyQ 疾病細胞模型藥物篩選；SCA17 小鼠模型來源。

en.name: National Taiwan Normal University
en.note: Drug screening in polyQ cell models; the source of the SCA17 mouse model.

name: 東海大學
note: SCA3 氧化壓力與代謝機轉；彰基團隊的長期學界夥伴。

en.name: Tunghai University
en.note: Oxidative stress and metabolism in SCA3; a long-standing academic partner of the CCH group.

name: 國立東華大學
note: 當歸萃取物與外泌體遞送治療 SCA3；與花蓮慈濟合作。

en.name: National Dong Hwa University
en.note: Angelica-extract and exosome delivery approaches in SCA3, in collaboration with Hualien Tzu Chi.

name: 台中慈濟醫院
note: 小腦疾病與平衡障礙門診。

en.name: Taichung Tzu Chi Hospital
en.note: A clinic for cerebellar disease and balance disorders.
